In the previous chapter, you have learnt the uses of 'who', 'how', 'what’, ‘when’, ‘where', 'which' and 'why' as question-words. Now we shall study their use as link-words.
‘who’ means ‘what/which person or persons’.
I don't know who she was speaking to.

‘how’ means ‘in what way’.
Look how I have done it.
I told him how he could open the safe.
‘what’ means ‘which particular thing or person’.
Tell me what she was talking about.
I wonder what he means.
‘when’ means ‘at what time'.
Tell me when you will be coming.

'where' means ‘in or to what place'.
Do you know where he is going?
I can't tell you where you can find him.
‘which’ means ‘what one or ones out of a group’.

‘why’ means 'for what reason'.
